description: Defines the ITransactionAgent interface used for transaction management within Orleans transactions system, including starting, resolving, and aborting transactions.

classes.name: ITransactionAgent
classes.description: Interface for transaction agent handling transaction lifecycle: start, resolve, and abort.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Initiates a new transaction, with optional read-only mode and timeout.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a transaction, committing or aborting as appropriate.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing transaction without exception.
